name: filter
title: Filter
description: Linear-style filtering on UI SDK: a Filter button (and F shortcut) opens a searchable Command of fields, then a searchable multi-select of values (an option search: the field keeps focus, the arrows move, Enter ticks); each filter is a chip with its own operator menu and value popover, removable with ×, Backspace or Delete. One Toolbar tab stop with arrow keys across the chips, announcements through UI SDK's announce(), change details with reason, source, event and cancel(), match all/any and Clear all.
